title: Create a new Module Federation remote app

name.description: Kebab-case app name (e.g. "invoice"). Becomes apps/<name>, the MF remote name, and the scope:<name> Nx tag.
name.x-prompt: What should the new remote app be called (kebab-case, e.g. invoice)?

displayName.description: Human-readable label used in the error boundary and placeholder content. Defaults to a capitalized version of --name.

port.description: Dev server port. Defaults to one past the highest port already used by an existing app.
